| Hour-long picks | A blocking bash call that fl"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"oods the context window | A background job with an id, `job_status`, and `job_kill` |"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"Requires a working `seismicx-catalog-skill` checkout and its Python environment."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"### From a local checkout (simplest)"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"`lib/` is not committed, so build once, then install the directory:"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"pnpm links the checkout, so it uses the `lib/` you just built and needs no build permission."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"### From GitHub"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"A git install fetches sources, not build output, so pnpm has to run this package's `prepare`
script "},{"id":"p15s2","text":"— and pnpm ≥10 refuses to do that until you allow it by name. The first `add` fails and
prints the k"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"ey; put it in the profile's `pnpm-workspace.yaml`:"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"then re-run, pinning a commit so a later push cannot silently change what executes:"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"That allowance is permission to execute this package's code on your machine at install time,
outside"},{"id":"p19s2","text":" any sandbox the agent runs under. `prepare` here is transpile-only (`tsc --noCheck`), so it
cannot "},{"id":"p19s3","text":"fail from peer-version drift the way a type-checking build would."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"### Configure"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"Point the plugin at the skill in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"The shipped `cordis.patch.yml` reads `SEISMICX_SKILL_ROOT` and `SEISMICX_PYTHON` from the
environmen"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"t instead, if you would rather not write the path into a file."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"Verify the wiring without touching any data:"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"then ask the agent to call `seismicx_list_models`."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"## Config"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"| Field | Default | Description |"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"| `skillRoot` | — (unset ⇒ inert) | Absolute path to the skill checkout |
| `python` | `python3` | I"},{"id":"p29s2","text":"nterpreter used for every subcommand |
| `workdir` | `.` | Directory relative output paths resolve a"},{"id":"p29s3","text":"gainst |
| `listModels` / `scan` / `pick` / `plotMap` | `true` | Register the corresponding tool |
|"},{"id":"p29s4","text":" `allowBackground` | `true` | Let `seismicx_pick` publish background jobs |
| `quickTimeoutMs` | `12"},{"id":"p29s5","text":"0000` | Budget for metadata subcommands |
| `pickTimeoutMs` | `3600000` | Budget for a **foreground*"},{"id":"p29s6","text":"* pick |
| `plotTimeoutMs` | `600000` | Budget for map rendering |"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"Unconfigured and misconfigured behave differently, on purpose:"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"- **`skillRoot` unset** — the plugin logs one line and registers no tools. Installing this bundle
ca"},{"id":"p31s2","text":"n never stop the harness from booting; an installed-but-not-yet-pointed-at plugin is
unconfigured, n"},{"id":"p31s3","text":"ot broken.
- **`skillRoot` set but relative** — fails loud at load, naming the offending row. That i"},{"id":"p31s4","text":"s genuine
misconfiguration, and the error belongs where it identifies the row rather than inside a t"},{"id":"p31s5","text":"ool
call the model has to interpret."},{"id":"p32s1","text":"Existence is deliberately not checked — the path may live in a sandbox or remote execution world
thi"},{"id":"p32s2","text":"s process cannot stat, and `ctx.subprocess` is what resolves it."},{"id":"p33s1","text":"The profile's `cordis.patch.yml` is watched, so correcting `skillRoot` or `python` takes effect
with"},{"id":"p33s2","text":"out restarting `dsh web`."},{"id":"p34s1","text":"## Tools"},{"id":"p35s1","text":"| Tool | Shape | Notes |"},{"id":"p36s1","text":"| `seismicx_list_models` | foreground, concurrency-safe | Call it first to verify `skillRoot`/`pytho"},{"id":"p36s2","text":"n` |
| `seismicx_scan` | foreground, concurrency-safe | Waveform inventory; confirms the archive is "},{"id":"p36s3","text":"readable |
| `seismicx_pick` | foreground **or background** | Set `run_in_background` for continuous"},{"id":"p36s4","text":" data |
| `seismicx_plot_map` | foreground, concurrency-safe | Returns `map_path`; carries `presenta"},{"id":"p36s5","text":"tionMeta` for a UI card |"},{"id":"p37s1","text":"`seismicx_pick` exposes no filtering argument, on purpose: the skill's standing rule is that
continu"},{"id":"p37s2","text":"ous waveforms reach the PNSN picker unfiltered."},{"id":"p38s1","text":"A background pick is owned by the calling agent, so agent disposal cancels and awaits it. A call
wit"},{"id":"p38s2","text":"h no agent behind it (a direct service invocation rather than a model turn) is refused rather
than l"},{"id":"p38s3","text":"eaking a multi-hour unowned run."},{"id":"p39s1","text":"## Design notes"},{"id":"p40s1","text":"**Everything goes through `ctx.subprocess`, never `node:child_process`.** The seam is what carries
t"},{"id":"p40s2","text":"he deployment's sandbox and remote-execution choices, so a composition that points `subprocess` at
a"},{"id":"p40s3","text":" remote runner moves these tools with it, unchanged."},{"id":"p41s1","text":"**`argv` is an array and is never shell-interpreted.** A station code or path containing shell
metac"},{"id":"p41s2","text":"haracters cannot escape into a command line."},{"id":"p42s1","text":"**A non-zero exit is a domain outcome, not a throw.** It is represented in the canonical value
(`exi"},{"id":"p42s2","text":"t_code`, `stderr_tail`) so callers can branch on it. Only spawn-level failures reject."},{"id":"p43s1","text":"**The Python process is not confined.** Confinement is a consumer responsibility in this
architectur"},{"id":"p43s2","text":"e — `ctx.shell`'s sandbox providers wrap argv before handing it to `ctx.subprocess`, and
this plugin"},{"id":"p43s3","text":" does not do that wrapping. Treat these tools as carrying the same trust level as the
bash tool: the"},{"id":"p43s4","text":"y run the interpreter you configured, with your ambient filesystem and network
access. Routing argv "},{"id":"p43s5","text":"through a `ctx.sandbox` backend is listed below as deferred work."},{"id":"p44s1","text":"## Not done yet"},{"id":"p45s1","text":"- **The remaining nine subcommands.** `polarity`, `associate`, `locate`, `magnitude-ml`,
`mechanism`"},{"id":"p45s2","text":", `analyze`, `build-tools`, `init-config`, and the end-to-end `catalog` follow the
same shape as `se"},{"id":"p45s3","text":"ismicx_scan`; adding one is mechanical.
- **Structured returns are shallow.** Tools report the paths"},{"id":"p45s4","text":" they were given plus exit facts, not
row counts or residual statistics, because the CLI prints pros"},{"id":"p45s5","text":"e. The clean fix belongs upstream:
a `--json` summary flag on the Python subcommands, which this plu"},{"id":"p45s6","text":"gin would then surface as typed
fields instead of `stdout_tail`.
